why: RJ-P13 (photo/tone-controls PT-4), pending TC-6 (suiteui/tone-controls, #4953): named .jobs.pending.json so the harness skips it, since tone.set's run throws notBuilt until TC-6 builds ToneCommands' bodies, and the folder has no input yet (the harness needs one). It is renamed to backlit.jobs.json when TC-6 lands, with input/backlit.png (a subject in shadow against a bright sky) and expected/backlit-lifted.png. The job: a new adjustment layer, then tone.set shadows 50, highlights -40 and contrast 15 on it, then a PNG export. The trap: the edit lands on the pixel layer instead of the adjustment layer. The assertions: the steps run on the adjustment layer, the pixel layer under it is unchanged, and the export matches the reference.
